openings.claim: An explicit ancestry ledger may reconcile the awkward amendment without counting its replacement twice. Quantity equality alone cannot establish cross-report record identity.
openings.delta: Change the decision dependency from report recency to documented supersession and cutoff/status semantics. The carrier is a twelve-batch ledger retaining every original row, unmatched row, duplicate, amendment reference, conversion and disposition. Convert U to V using only the supplied factor five. Treat same-quantity rows under different identifiers as candidate aliases until supporting references establish identity; otherwise preserve their disagreement. An undefined status or missing supersession link blocks only conclusions depending on that field.
openings.prediction: Against the nearest rival, selecting the newer report after conversion, the ledger should expose whether both reports already represent the replacement and distinguish unresolved duplicates from documented superseded rows. Under disturbance it should increase bounded disagreements or named missing-field requests rather than fabricate a definite quantity. These are predictions, not measured results.
openings.probe: Within the sixty-minute reviewer budget, allocate two twenty-five-minute passes to the two workflow variants on the unchanged copy and a ten-minute ledger/output check. Each variant emits twelve quantities or bounded disagreements with record citations and at most three requests naming missing fields/records. Use the extra twenty minutes to challenge both frozen outputs against the disturbed copy, freeze revised outputs, then open the sealed key and compare resolved-batch counts, unsupported definite claims and request counts. Preserve all affected disagreements if more than three missing fields remain. Defeat: the ledger produces unsupported certainty, loses rows, exceeds capacity, or yields fewer correct resolutions without reducing unsupported claims. If timed passes cannot cover all records, feasibility is unestablished; a time cap alone is insufficient.
assumptions: The stipulated references and dictionary permit some explicit lineage decisions; cross-report identity may remain absent.
Sixty rows and eight amendments may exceed the proposed pass capacity.
No missing quantity is inferred from another batch; no undefined status receives invented semantics.

assessment: One testable opening; resources and observations are synthetic stipulations. All constraints remain binding. Deployment and successful reconciliation are unproven; unresolved cases require bounded disagreement, even when the three-request limit prevents querying every gap.
